name: weak-off-kit
about: The clean-highway ad with the plate drawn hot pink (#D6007E) for a carrier whose colours are dark green and white.

truth.how: the plate is a colour far from both of the carrier's colours

subject_legible.reason: A white semi-truck and trailer rolling on an open road at sunset is instantly recognizable at a glance.

words_match_picture.reason: The OTR headline pairs naturally with an open-road trucking photo, telling one clear story about long-haul driving.

hierarchy_reads.reason: The large magenta panel anchors the headline boldly, the button text is clear, and the photo above does not compete with the text.

looks_like_kit.reason: The dominant magenta/hot-pink color is far from the brand's given primary (#0B3D2E dark green) and no logo appears, so the ad feels off-brand.
